summary: Angle parking beside a sports field, no homes nearby, many cars parked.
reasons: No dwellings, only university stores and sheds
Row of cars already parked along edge

drivers.seclusion: Playing field and tree line on the west, university stores and yard on the east; nearest building 20 m, none a dwelling.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a line of angle bays on the west edge, about 20 cars in them; room for a van among them.
drivers.traffic: Light campus traffic; lane serves stores and a depot.
drivers.convention: Signed 4P angle parking; many cars parked, so a van blends in.

flags: Industrial yard and construction noise nearby
sun_shade: Open to the sky; tree line on the west gives some afternoon shade.
rubbish: Scrap and rubbish in the yard across the road; none on the kerb.

best_section.where: west edge of Walcott Street, in the angle bays beside the playing field
